actions.name: compromised trusted software distribution channels by injecting malicious code into legitimate packages
actions.description: TeamPCP compromised trusted software distribution channels by injecting malicious code into legitimate packages to modify software components and development dependencies.

actions.name: pushed trojanized updates that installed credential-stealing malware and persistent backdoors
actions.description: TeamPCP pushed trojanized updates that appeared normal but secretly installed credential-stealing malware and persistent backdoors, giving persistent access to developer environments and downstream systems.

actions.name: modified tools including Trivy, KICS, LiteLLM, and the Telnyx Python SDK
actions.description: TeamPCP modified tools including, but not limited to, Trivy, KICS, LiteLLM, and the Telnyx Python SDK, which are commonly integrated into enterprise development CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and security workflows.

actions.name: introduced malicious code into victim environments at scale via supply chain entry points
actions.description: By weaponizing supply chain entry points, TeamPCP introduced malicious code into victim environments at scale.

actions.name: engaged in extortion and collaboration with other cyber actors
actions.description: TeamPCP engaged in extortion and collaboration with cyber actors from other threat actor groups, including publishing victim names on a public leak site and threatening disclosure of stolen data.

actions.name: deployed CanisterWorm malware
actions.description: TeamPCP deployed CanisterWorm, designed to harvest sensitive information including cloud access tokens, credentials, API keys, and other authentication material associated with AWS, GCP, and Microsoft Azure.

actions.name: deployed SANDCLOCK credential stealing tool
actions.description: TeamPCP used SANDCLOCK, a credential stealing tool that extracts AWS credentials, Kubernetes ServiceAccount tokens, local environment variables, and cryptocurrency wallet data.

actions.name: deployed Mini Shai-Hulud self-replicating software supply chain worm
actions.description: TeamPCP deployed Mini Shai-Hulud, a self-replicating, cross-ecosystem (npm/PyPI) software supply chain worm campaign.

actions.name: deployed Miasma variant of Mini Shai-Hulud
actions.description: TeamPCP deployed Miasma, a variant of Mini Shai-Hulud that self-propagates across open-source registries such as npm and PyPI, harvesting credentials and poisoning configuration files.
